review: Final SchoolEscape 0.10 settled screenshot visual review
method: Direct visual inspection using view_image of the four listed 1440 x 900 evidence PNGs. No browser, runtime, Unity, or interaction test was run by this reviewer.
conclusion: No blocking visual defect found in the four inspected desktop views. Presentation is legible as a playable prototype, with temporary geometric art and minor entrance occlusion remaining.

artifact.packagingStatus: The repository Playable/SchoolEscape-play.html remains the previous 0.9 package intentionally while final validation completes. The parent agent will refresh it after validation. This is not a concurrent rebuild discrepancy.

observations.finding: Player is clearly visible below a contrasting pale entrance apron. The north portal label identifies return to main-building floor 1. Fence, apron and doorway distinguish the entry area from open yard.

South exit reads as a barred gate between lit posts, with an explicit A/B/C key requirement. The minimap places the player next to the south exit marker. This looks distinct from the north building doorway.

A high-contrast central field line and dotted circle orient the open yard. Offset planters provide distinct landmarks and leave visible space around the centered character. Uniform, hair and limb silhouette remain readable against the lit ground.

Indoor map title and room layout distinguish the building from the yard. Both the doorway sign and large E interaction prompt identify the yard transition. The player is partly hidden by the doorway/sign in this particular settled position.

Objective, key slots, inventory count, stamina, movement controls, audio controls and minimap occupy stable separated screen areas. No cropped panels or overlapping HUD text were observed at 1440 x 900. Secondary hints and minimap legend are small and subdued but discernible at inspected resolution.

remainingTemporaryArt: Character uses a simple geometric uniformed humanoid rather than finished character artwork.
Planters, bushes, fencing, gate and door remain stylized primitive geometry; ground and building surfaces use simple repeated textures.
Portal signs are functional rectangular labels. The indoor doorway/sign can obscure part of the player at the interaction position.
Yard intentionally contains broad open ground; these frames establish layout and navigability, not dense final environmental dressing.
limitations: Screenshots cannot establish collision, interaction correctness, animation quality, audio, pursuit behavior, or performance.
The four images alone do not establish the complete authored fixture count or prove that no other functional escape gate exists; those are covered by separate map/runtime evidence.
Only the supplied 1440 x 900 desktop views were visually reviewed; mobile layouts and other viewport sizes were not assessed.
Existing core and browser pass totals are separate evidence and were not rerun or independently claimed in this visual review.

packagingFollowup.note: Repository playable refreshed from the exact tested candidate after the visual audit.
